_comment: Optional catalog overrides for the Phase-3 name->GUID resolver.
Copy this file to 'catalog_overrides.json' at the repo root (or point
BADZURE_CATALOG_OVERRIDES at it) to teach the resolver about Entra roles or
Graph/Exchange app-role permissions that src/constants.py doesn't list yet,
or to correct a stale GUID. Entries here win over the built-in catalog.
Names are matched case-insensitively; values must be permission/role GUIDs.
